title: ToolResult
description: Result of a tool.call; ok=false becomes an MCP isError result.

structured.description: Optional structured result matching the tool result schema; null when the tool only returns text.

anchor.description: Set when the call ended the caller's task (complete_task): the new task anchor, "" to clear the stored one (as session.send anchor).

download.description: read_deliverable: files whose bytes arrived before as file.download frames; the daemon writes them under .agent-deliverables/<deliverable_id>/v<version>/ in the session's working directory.

shared_download.description: read_shared_file: the one file the daemon writes as .shared/<path> in the session's working directory (the folder holds its own .gitignore). Its bytes arrived before as file.download frames, or (daemons with attachments_v2) the file entry carries a url to GET, chunks is 0 and no frames are sent.

attachment_download.description: read_attachment: the attachment the daemon downloads to .attachments/<id>-<name> in the session's working directory (the folder holds its own .gitignore); the daemon replaces this with local_path in what the AI sees and never shows it the url.

chunks.description: Number of file.download frames (0 when every file is empty).

path.description: Path inside the deliverable version (index.html, assets/logo.svg …), or the shared-files path for shared_download.

url.description: attachments_v2 shared_download: presigned GET URL of the file (the daemon downloads it directly and checks size and sha256; chunks is 0). Never shown to the AI.

chunks.description: Number of file.download frames (0 when the file is empty or files[0].url is set; at most 20 for the 20 MB chunked limit).

files.description: Exactly one file; path is its shared-files path (data/sample.csv), same rules as the tools' SharedPath.

url.description: Presigned GET URL, valid until expires_at. Null or absent for legacy rows: the daemon fetches GET /nodes/attachments/<id> with its node token instead.
